name: 40202 · Louisville, KY
findings: ZIP 40202 (Louisville) has 313 nonprofit organizations. 128 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 112 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40202 (Louisville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
70% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 40202 (Louisville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.3 times the typical level).
